title: SQL EXISTS Operator
text:
SQL
EXISTS Operator



The SQL EXISTS Operator

The
EXISTS
operator is used in a
WHERE
clause
to check whether a subquery returns any rows.

The
EXISTS
operator evaluates to TRUE if the subquery returns at least one row, and FALSE otherwise.

EXISTS Syntax

SELECT
column_name(s)

FROM
table_name

WHERE
EXISTS (
subquery
);
